findings.primary_inspection: No ledger, output or authorization binds generalship/command.py (the command ledgers bind design, cohort, registry and, in v2, addendum); frozen imputation.impute calls check_command at imputation.py:205.

safe_path raises ValueError on escape (sources.py:24-28), read_json raises on invalid JSON and a missing file raises FileNotFoundError; any of these escaping the resolver would replace the checker's Dossier binding message.
If one ledger binds the live bytes and another an archive, comparing only substitutions would substitute the archive and fail the first ledger falsely.
Recomputed: 1,601 registry entries, 1,555 distinct files, 345.2 MB (329.2 MiB).
ratings.py RUNS[1] reads 'artifacts/estimate-evaluation.json'; the Makefile orders only v2 (commander-ratings-v2: estimate-evaluation-v2).
Section 6 required archive permanence in the contract but section 4 did not schedule it; the installation record now goes in a new file beside the immutable review bundle.
Until installation every integration view is a no-op, so a simulated installation is the only pre-installation test of the substitution path with the real checkers.

Correct and material: views accept ledgers bound to any reachable archived version, and only the rating and evaluation runs anchor ledger bytes through authorization hashes. Disclosure applied; anchoring every replay to authorization hashes was considered and not adopted, because replay never authenticated ledger bytes and the runs already anchor them.

advisory.A1: adopted in section 6 (metadata changes on hard-linked view files)
advisory.A2: not adopted; the final hash comparison already decides, so the extra battle-ID check adds nothing to soundness
advisory.A3: adopted in section 4 step 3 (byte-identical outputs are the evidence of equivalence at a later code commit)
advisory.A4: not adopted; one view per run keeps the design simple, and a conflict there would be a real error
advisory.A6: adopted in section 5 (run callers verified only by the section 4 reproduction)
